post.summary: Mint a JWT access token (OAuth 2.0 client_credentials)
post.description:
Exchange a `sk_live_*` or `sk_int_*` API key for a short-lived JWT access token + refresh token.

**Body** (JSON or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`):
- `grant_type`: must be `client_credentials`
- `client_id`: the client_id shown with the key; it must match the API key row UUID or displayed key prefix and must not be the secret
- `client_secret`: the full `sk_live_*` or `sk_int_*` key
- `scope` (optional): space-separated subset of the key's allowed scopes

**Response** (RFC 6749):
```json
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "refresh_token": "rt_...",
  "scope": "documents:send documents:read"
}
```

**Errors** use Peppol error envelope: `{ error: { category, code, message, retryable, correlation_id, details? } }`.

Failed-credential throttling: after 5 invalid attempts within 15 min, repeated exact-pair attempts and further invalid guesses targeting the same `client_id` return 423. A valid secret is authenticated before client-wide failure state is enforced and remains usable.

This endpoint is the canonical Enterprise URL; `/sapi/v1/auth/token` is the SAPI-spec equivalent and shares the same handler.

403.description: Requested scope(s) not allowed by key

423.description: Invalid credential attempts throttled after 5 failures; valid credentials remain usable

post.summary: Refresh access token using a refresh token
post.description:
Rotate a refresh token: returns a new access JWT (15 min) + a new refresh token (30 days). The old refresh token is invalidated.

**Body**:
```json
{ "grant_type": "refresh_token", "refresh_token": "rt_..." }
```

Refresh tokens are stateless JWTs verified server-side via Redis presence — once consumed, they cannot be reused (replay → 401).

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired, or already consumed

post.summary: Revoke an access or refresh token (RFC 7009)
post.description:
Idempotent — always returns 200. Revoking an access token adds its `jti` to the Redis blocklist for the remainder of its lifetime. Revoking a refresh token deletes its server-side state.

**Body**:
```json
{ "token": "<jwt or refresh token>", "token_type_hint": "access_token" | "refresh_token" }
```

`token_type_hint` is optional; the server detects the type automatically (`eyJ` prefix → JWT, `rt_` prefix → refresh).

200.description: Token revoked (or was already invalid — idempotent)

post.description:
Odosle fakturu cez Peppol siet. Podporuje dva rezimy:

**JSON mode** — poskytnete strukturovane data (`items`) pre standardnu fakturu, UBL XML sa vygeneruje automaticky. Odosielatel sa berie z autentifikovanej firmy, nie z payloadu.

**XML mode** — poskytnete hotove UBL XML (`xml`), odosle sa priamo.

V oboch pripadoch je `receiverPeppolId` povinne.

**Idempotency (always strict):** pass `Idempotency-Key: <any unique string>` (alias `X-Idempotency-Key`) to safely retry after network errors — the second completed call with the same body returns HTTP 200 with the current document status and `duplicate: true`, without creating or sending another document. If the same key is currently being processed, returns 409 CONFLICT. If the body SHA-256 differs from the stored hash, returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH (body is canonicalized — keys sorted recursively — before hashing). There is no non-strict mode.

**Cross-path dedup (XML mode):** if the same UBL XML SHA-256 was already accepted for this firm via dashboard mass-import, returns 200 with `{ data: { invoice_id, peppol_message_id, status, duplicate: true } }`.

**Items[] max 999.** Unit codes use UN/ECE Rec 20 (C62, HUR, KGM, MTR, LTR, DAY, ...).

**Attachments (BG-24):** up to 20 files, 10 MB per file, 15 MB total after base64 decode. MIME types enforced per BR-CL-22.

**Required scope:** `documents:send`. Wildcard scopes (`*`, `full`, or empty `[]`) also satisfy this requirement.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-supplied idempotency key (canonical RFC-draft header). If the same key was used recently with the same body, the prior response is replayed.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Alias for `Idempotency-Key`. Both headers are accepted.

value.note: Services for June 2026. Attachment: signed acceptance protocol.

Two distinct failure shapes return 422 here: (a) UBL pre-flight rule violation — body matches UblValidationError with `code: "UBL_VALIDATION_ERROR"` and a `rule` field naming the violated BR-* / BT-* / PEPPOL-R* code; (b) IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH — same X-Idempotency-Key was replayed with a different request body hash, body matches the generic ErrorResponse.

post.summary: Send up to 50 documents in one call
post.description: Batch version of `/documents/send`. Each item is dispatched through the regular send pipeline and returns its own status + documentId (or per-item error). Partial success is expected — the HTTP status is 200 even if some items fail; inspect each result. Body size cap: 20 MB (use individual sends for larger batches).

Enterprise reliability contract: capability -> preflight -> send -> events -> support. Dry-run send without creating a document or billing usage; run it after capability checks and before POST /documents/send. Read decision/canSend/errors/checks for the result, and retry the later send call with the same Idempotency-Key when it is the same payload.

Streams the raw multipart AS4 envelope for this document from the Enterprise API evidence archive exactly as it was transmitted on the Peppol network — signed, timestamped, tamper-evident. The archive is available during the active contract term and for 30 days after termination for export; it is not a standalone accounting archive outside the contract. Response headers include `X-Envelope-Archived-At` (ISO 8601) and `X-Envelope-Direction` (inbound|outbound).

Archive cron runs on a short interval, so brand-new documents may briefly 404 until archived.

**Requires an API-eligible actor: `api-enterprise` directly, or `integrator-managed` through the managing integrator.**

post.summary: Capability probe — does receiver accept this doctype?
post.description:
Storecove-style `discovery/receives`: given a participant + optional candidate document type + process id, answer whether the receiver accepts it. Enterprise reliability contract starts here: before building the payload, read `networkReady` and `matchedDocumentTypes`, then continue capability -> preflight -> send -> events -> support.

When `documentType` or `processId` are omitted, the endpoint defaults to BIS Billing 3.0 Invoice over the BIS Billing process. Response `matchedDocumentType` is the probed document type when accepted, otherwise `null`. Send `documentTypes[]` to check 1-20 document type URNs in one request; the response includes `capabilities[]` and `matchedDocumentTypes[]`.

bearerAuth.description:
OAuth 2.0 client_credentials JWT access token (15 min TTL).

**Obtain a token:** `POST /api/v1/auth/token` with the `client_id` shown with the key plus `client_secret` (the full `sk_live_*` or `sk_int_*` API key). Response contains `access_token` (JWT) and `refresh_token`.

**Use the JWT:** `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...`

**Two key types:**
- JWT minted from `sk_live_*` — direct firm access, no X-Firm-Id needed.
- JWT minted from `sk_int_*` — requires `X-Firm-Id: <UUID>` header to target a specific assigned firm. For cross-firm endpoints (`/documents/inbox/all`, `/webhook-queue/all`, `/firms/assign`) X-Firm-Id is not required.

**Direct API key bearer (Bearer sk_live_… or Bearer sk_int_…) is no longer accepted.**

Rate limit: 200 requests per minute per key.

LineItem.description: One JSON billing line. Required fields are description, quantity, unitPrice and vatRate. Standard lines require quantity > 0; advance_deduction lines require quantity < 0 and advanceInvoiceReference. For an exempt or non-taxable line, taxExemptionReasonCode carries BT-121 and taxExemptionReason carries BT-120; the current v1 contract keeps these additive fields unconstrained for backward compatibility while runtime applies the documented string limits. Unknown advanced fields are not mapped into UBL.

quantity.description: Quantity. Must be greater than zero for a standard line. Must be negative for lineType=advance_deduction; zero is never accepted.

unit.description: UN/ECE Rec 20 unit code. Use H87 for a piece; C62 is the generic one/unit code. Short aliases are also mapped: ks=H87, kus=H87, piece=H87, pcs=H87, jednotka=C62, unit=C62, one=C62, hod=HUR, den=DAY, mes=MON, kg=KGM, m=MTR, l=LTR, km=KTM. Omitted values default to C62.

unitPrice.description: Net price per unit. Must be a finite non-negative number.

vatRate.description: VAT rate in percent. Accepted values: 0, 5, 10, 19, 20, 23; this includes historical 20% for older/corrective documents. Z, AE, E, K, G and O categories require 0; S, L and M require a positive rate.

vatCategoryCode.description: DPH category BT-151 according to UNCL5305. A positive rate may derive S. At 0%, vatCategoryCode or taxTreatment is required because 0% can represent Z, E, AE, K, G or O.

taxTreatment.description: Higher-level ePostak tax treatment mapped to vatCategoryCode: standard=S, zero_rate=Z, reverse_charge_domestic=AE, exempt=E, intra_community_supply=K, export=G, outside_scope=O. Explicit vatCategoryCode wins when both are present.

discount.description: Line discount percentage from 0 to 100. Omitted means 0.

deliveryDate.description: Line delivery date (BT-134). ISO timestamps are accepted by the route and emitted as date-only in UBL. When line delivery dates represent a summary invoice, they must stay within one calendar month and issueDate must be no later than the 15th day after that month ends.

lineType.description: Line type. Use advance_deduction for a negative advance deduction line on the final invoice.

advanceInvoiceReference.description: Advance invoice number. Required when lineType is advance_deduction. Emitted to UBL as AdditionalItemProperty named AdvanceInvoiceNumber.

customsTariffCode.description: Customs tariff / combined nomenclature code. Emitted as CommodityClassification/ItemClassificationCode listID=HS; KV DPH A2 uses the first 4 digits as TK.

commodityClassificationCode.description: Generic item classification code when customsTariffCode is not used. Send together with commodityClassificationListId when the list is not HS.

commodityClassificationListId.description: Classification list identifier from UNTDID 7143. Defaults to HS for customsTariffCode.

reverseChargeParagraphLetter.description: Domestic §69(12) paragraph letter for reverse-charge evidence, for example f or g. Emitted as AdditionalItemProperty.

controlStatementType.description: Slovak KV DPH A2 TD value.

controlStatementQuantity.description: Positive Slovak KV DPH A2 Mn quantity. If omitted and the unit can be mapped, the absolute line quantity is used.

controlStatementUnit.description: Slovak KV DPH A2 MJ unit.

Prepayment.description: One settled prepayment on a final invoice. amountWithVat is the only required field and contributes to BT-113 PrepaidAmount. All monetary fields must be finite non-negative numbers and are rounded to two decimals. References, settlement date and VAT details are preserved in the UBL note; it does not create a separate UBL tax breakdown.

advanceInvoiceRef.description: Advance/prepayment invoice reference from the ERP.

taxDocumentRef.description: Tax document number for the received advance payment.

settlementDate.description: Settlement date in strict YYYY-MM-DD format.

vatAmount.description: VAT amount from the settled prepayment.

amountWithVat.description: Settled amount including VAT. Required and summed into prepaidAmount.

vatRate.description: Non-negative VAT rate of the prepayment. This is descriptive prepayment metadata and is preserved in the UBL note.

vatCategoryCode.description: Optional VAT category of the prepayment. Values are normalized to uppercase and preserved as prepayment metadata.

allOf.description: A successful JSON billing request needs a Peppol recipient ID. Use receiverPeppolId for invoice/credit_note; self-billing may use supplierPeppolId.
A successful JSON billing request needs the counterparty legal name. Use receiverName for invoice/credit_note; self-billing may use supplierName.

SendDocumentJsonRequest.description: Complete JSON billing contract shared by Enterprise send and Connector. UBL XML is generated automatically for invoice, credit_note, correction (384), debit_note (383), prepayment_invoice (386), self_billing and self_billing_credit_note. Only items is unconditionally required under one fixed field name; a successful request also needs one accepted Peppol recipient ID and one accepted counterparty name. receiverPeppolId and receiverName are required for invoice/credit_note, while self-billing may use supplierPeppolId and supplierName. Credit-note types, debit_note and correction additionally require precedingInvoiceRef. correction is data-only: all unit prices and prepaidAmount must be zero, and invoiceNumber must be new and unique. Sender fields are not accepted: the authenticated firm is the supplier for regular invoices/credit notes and the buyer for self-billing. Unknown fields are not mapped into the generated UBL.

processId.description: Peppol process URN. Accepts the bare URN or the cenbii-procid-ubl:: prefixed form. Defaults to profile 01; use urn:peppol:bis:billing_with_response to require an Invoice Response.

documentType.description: Business document type. invoice is a supplier-issued invoice; credit_note corrects a supplier-issued invoice; self_billing is a buyer-issued invoice; self_billing_credit_note corrects a buyer-issued invoice. correction uses InvoiceTypeCode 384 for data-only changes: all unit prices and prepaidAmount must be zero, with a new unique invoiceNumber and precedingInvoiceRef. debit_note uses InvoiceTypeCode 383 and requires an original invoice reference. prepayment_invoice uses InvoiceTypeCode 386; it is a separate invoice, not a proforma or a final invoice prepayments entry. Defaults to invoice.

document_type.description: Snake_case alias for documentType. If multiple aliases are sent, all non-empty values must match.

docType.description: Compatibility alias for documentType. Do not send conflicting alias values.

receiverPeppolId.description: Peppol participant ID in scheme:identifier form, for example 0245:2123456789. Required for invoice/credit_note and identifies the buyer. For self-billing it identifies the supplier/Peppol recipient, but supplierPeppolId is the clearer alias.

supplierPeppolId.description: Self-billing alias for the supplier/Peppol recipient in scheme:identifier form. Allowed only for self_billing and self_billing_credit_note; it is normalized into receiverPeppolId.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice or credit-note number. If omitted or empty, ePošťák allocates the next number from the authenticated firm's numbering sequence.

precedingInvoiceRef.description: External original invoice number adjusted by this corrective document. Required for credit_note, correction (384), debit_note and self_billing_credit_note; emitted as UBL BillingReference.

issueDate.description: Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Through 2026 a supplied value is preserved. From 1 January 2027 the legal issue date is the Europe/Bratislava handoff day; generated JSON is normalized and raw UBL with a different IssueDate is rejected.

dueDate.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional.

taxPointDate.description: VAT tax point date (BT-7) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Kept separate from the actual delivery date.

deliveryDate.description: Actual delivery date for the whole document (BT-72) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

documentDiscountPercent.description: Document-level discount percentage represented as a Peppol BG-20 allowance. This is additional to any items[].discount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. If omitted, the authenticated firm's default currency is used, falling back to EUR.

note.description: Free-text invoice note. Use it for a human-readable exemption/reverse-charge reason or other information the receiver must see.

iban.description: Payment IBAN. If omitted, the authenticated firm's saved IBAN is used when available.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method. Accepted convenience aliases: bank_transfer=30, credit_transfer=30, sepa=58, card=48, cash=10, direct_debit=49. A direct UNCL4461 code such as 30 is also accepted. Omitted defaults to 30 in generated UBL.

variableSymbol.description: Variable symbol / payment reference included with payment means.

buyerReference.description: Buyer reference, purchase-order number, or internal procurement reference.

receiverName.description: Counterparty legal/business name. Required for invoice/credit_note. For self-billing it identifies the supplier, but supplierName is the clearer alias.

receiverIcDph.description: Counterparty VAT identification number (IČ DPH). For self-billing it is also used to determine supplier-side VAT-payer treatment.

receiverStreet.description: Receiver street and number. Preferred over parsing receiverAddress.

receiverAddress.description: Single-line counterparty address. Prefer receiverStreet, receiverCity and receiverPostalCode when the ERP has split address fields.

receiverCountry.description: Counterparty country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Defaults to SK.

supplierName.description: Self-billing alias for receiverName (supplier). Required for self_billing/self_billing_credit_note when receiverName is omitted.

supplierIcDph.description: Self-billing alias for receiverIcDph. Used for supplier-side VAT payer logic.

prepaidAmount.description: Amount paid in advance (BT-113). Emitted as LegalMonetaryTotal/PrepaidAmount and reduces PayableAmount. Do not combine with items[].lineType=advance_deduction.

prepayments.description: Structured settled prepayments on the final invoice. The API sums prepayments[].amountWithVat into prepaidAmount, reduces PayableAmount, and preserves advance/tax references in the UBL note. It does not create a separate UBL tax breakdown for the prepayment; tax subtotals still come from invoice lines. Do not combine with items[].lineType=advance_deduction.

items.description: Billing lines. Between 1 and 999 entries are accepted.

attachments.description: Invoice supporting documents (Peppol BG-24), embedded in UBL as base64 through AdditionalDocumentReference / EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject. Maximum 20 files, 10 MB decoded per file, and 15 MB decoded total.

DocumentAttachment.description: Invoice attachment encoded as base64 without a data: prefix. The declared MIME type is checked against file magic bytes. Maximum decoded size is 10 MB per file and 15 MB across all attachments.

mimeType.description: Allowed MIME types according to Peppol BR-CL-22. The decoded content must match this MIME type.

content.description: Base64-encoded file content without a data: prefix. Must decode to a non-empty file and may be at most 10 MB after decoding.

description.description: Optional short attachment description shown as supporting-document metadata.

SendDocumentXmlRequest.description: XML mode — poskytnute UBL XML sa odosle priamo v JSON poli xml. Pouzite ho ako expert fallback pre hotovy Peppol UBL alebo specifika mimo JSON line-item mode.

processId.description: Peppol process URN. Accepts the bare URN or the cenbii-procid-ubl:: prefixed form. For profile 02 use urn:peppol:bis:billing_with_response; it must match the UBL ProfileID.

SendDocumentLinks.description: Convenience links for the created outbound document submission.

submissionId.description: Storecove-style alias for documentId. Use this as the submission handle if your integration models sends as submissions.

status.description: Current document lifecycle status. The first successful call normally returns `SENT`; an HTTP 200 idempotent replay returns the latest persisted status such as `SENT`, `DELIVERED`, or `REJECTED`. `SENT_DB_PENDING` = HTTP 202 (delivered via Peppol but local DB write failed; reconciled by the post-send cron).

duplicate.description: True only for HTTP 200 idempotent replay responses.

payloadSha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical UBL XML bytes that were placed on the AS4 wire. Receivers can verify the payload they received off Peppol matches what we logged on send. Only present in `SENT` (201) responses; absent in `SENT_DB_PENDING` (202) because the DB persist that captures it failed.

warning.description: Human-readable explanation when `status=SENT_DB_PENDING` — describes the partial-failure mode and what reconciliation will do.
warning.example: Document delivered via Peppol but local status update failed — will be reconciled automatically

process_id.description: Canonical bare Peppol process URN. Historical null values mean the legacy profile 01.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. null when no more results.

InboxDocumentDetailResponse.description: Inbox document detail. `document` and `payload` are siblings (payload is NOT nested inside document). `document` matches the normalized shape from `lib/api/format.ts#formatInvoice` — supplier/customer are nested PartyResponse objects (supplier.peppolId carries the original sender).

payload.description: UBL XML content (null if not yet retrieved from storage). Starts with `<?xml...?>`.

clientAckedAt.description: Cas prveho lokalneho potvrdenia spracovania. Pri idempotentnom opakovani sa nemeni.

idempotent.description: True, ak uz bolo spracovanie dokumentu zaznamenane skor.

extraction.description: The exact extraction object returned by /payloads/extract or by a previous /payloads/review response. Provider diagnostics and unknown fields are ignored.

fields.description: All human corrections in one object. Supported keys include supplier and buyer identity, dates, payment data, amounts, items and document_type.

review_decision.description: Explicit human approval after checking the corrected result. Approval cannot clear technical, tenant, validation or high-risk blockers.

direction.description: For issued invoice PDFs this is outbound. Standard invoices include send_payload instead of treating OCR as an immediate send.

send_payload.description: Draft JSON body for POST /api/v1/documents/send. Returned for outbound standard-invoice OCR; caller must review it, fill missing fields, and submit it separately. Null for outbound document types outside the JSON send flow.

send_payload_missing_fields.description: Fields the caller must fill before POST /api/v1/documents/send, commonly receiverPeppolId.

send_ready.description: True when send_payload has the blocking fields needed by /documents/send; review is still required.

ubl_xml.description: Vygenerovane UBL XML z extrahovanych dat. Present for inbound extraction; outbound standard invoices return send_payload for review instead.

confidence_scores.description: Compatibility projection of the document-level OCR confidence (0..1) onto commonly reviewed fields. These values are not independent per-field model scores. Fields: vendor_name, vendor_ico, invoice_number, issue_date, due_date, items, subtotal, vat_total, total, currency, iban, variable_symbol.

needs_review.description: True when human review is still required. Correcting fields does not automatically clear this flag: it remains true while a blocking missing field, deferred or failed validation, low/medium OCR confidence, or high vendor-risk signal remains. Direct /payloads/extract outbound responses are always review-only; /payloads/review can clear that review only after explicit review_decision=approve and no non-bypassable blocker. Use missing_fields and next_action to decide what to do next.

review_approved.description: Present on /payloads/review. True only when review_decision=approve was accepted after all non-bypassable blockers cleared.

ocr_reused.description: Present on /payloads/review and always true, proving that the correction step reused the supplied extraction instead of invoking OCR again.

applied_overrides.description: Names of values from the fields object that were accepted and applied to this extraction. On /payloads/extract fields is multipart JSON; on /payloads/review it is a JSON object. Empty when no corrections were supplied.

missing_fields.description: Blocking fields that must still be completed. An empty list does not by itself guarantee needs_review=false because validation, confidence, or risk can still require review.

field_sources.description: Per-field provenance after OCR, firm-profile enrichment, directory lookup, inference, and API overrides.

value.description: Resolved JSON value. Its type depends on the field and the value may be null when the source is missing.

next_action.description: The next safe integration step after extraction and any supplied corrections.

anyOf.description: Structured error for /extract — Gemini extraction failure.
Compatibility plain-string error for /extract — UBL generation failure path.

extraction.description: Partial extraction payload (so caller can retry with manual edits)

url.description: HTTPS URL (http rejected, private/loopback/metadata addresses rejected by SSRF filter)

events.description: Accepted event filters. If omitted, subscribes to the 7 live event types. document.created and document.validated are accepted for v1 request compatibility but are not emitted by current production flows.

failedAttempts.description: Consecutive failure counter. Webhooks auto-disable after 10 consecutive failures.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret (vrateny iba pri vytvoreni)

webhookId.description: Per-attempt delivery ID sent as X-Webhook-Id request header. Different on each retry attempt. Distinct from idempotency_key which is per-logical-event.

idempotency_key.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex identifying the logical delivery event (per PR #112). Stable across retry attempts — two attempts for the same logical event share the same idempotency_key. Distinct from webhook_id (X-Webhook-Id header), which is per-attempt.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope for `/api/v1/*` endpoints (excluding `/auth/token|renew|revoke` which use `PeppolErrorResponse`, and `/oauth/token` which uses RFC 6749 `OAuthErrorResponse`). The `requestId` echoes the `X-Request-Id` response header — quote it in support tickets.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code. Branch on this value, not only on HTTP status. Known codes:
- VALIDATION_ERROR (422) - JSON, XML shape, or required field validation failed; fix the payload and retry.
- UBL_VALIDATION_ERROR (422) - Peppol/CEN schematron rejection; inspect details[].rule such as BR-CO-26.
- UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY (422) - business rule rejection.
- IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH (422) - the same Idempotency-Key was reused with a different canonicalized body.
- IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT (409) - the same idempotency key is still processing; wait and poll status.
- CONNECTOR_LEGACY_IDEMPOTENCY_OWNER_UNPROVEN (409) - a pre-deploy Connector send cannot yet prove the historical key owner; if retryable=true wait 30 seconds and retry the exact same key/body, never change the key; if retryable=false do not resubmit and contact support.
- AUTOPILOT_REPLAY_MISMATCH (409) - the command changed or a historical direct reference is reserved in another/unproven ownership namespace; no timed retry, reconcile first.
- CONNECTOR_OUTBOX_REFERENCE_RESERVED (409) - a historical outbox item without proven integrator ownership already reserves the ERP reference; reconcile first.
- NOT_FOUND (404).
- FORBIDDEN (403) - plan, scope, or ownership denied.
- CONFLICT (409) - duplicate or unique-constraint collision.
- BAD_REQUEST (400) - malformed body or parameters.
- INVALID_PARAM (400).
- PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (413).
- RATE_LIMITED (429) - respect Retry-After when present.
- VALIDATION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503) - retry with backoff.
- IDEMPOTENCY_STORE_UNAVAILABLE (503) - retry the same payload with the same Idempotency-Key.
- SEND_FAILED (502) - Peppol AP dispatch failed, retryable when the same payload and key are used.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503) - upstream dependency unavailable.
- INTERNAL_ERROR (500).
Business error catalog:
- participant_not_found (422) - retryable=false; fix_hint=change or verify the receiver Peppol ID.
- receiver_unsupported_document_type (422) - retryable=false; fix_hint=change document type/profile or receiver capability.
- validation_failed (422) - retryable=false; fix_hint=fix the UBL/JSON payload using details/rule.
- temporary_transport_error (502/503) - retryable=true; fix_hint=retry with backoff and the same Idempotency-Key.
- delivery_dead_lettered (409) - retryable=false; fix_hint=inspect events/support-packet, then retry manually or contact support.
- duplicate_idempotency_key (422) - retryable=false; fix_hint=send the original body or use a new key for changed payload.

requestId.description: Mirror of the `X-Request-Id` response header — for tracing.

details.description: Optional structured details (e.g., Zod error array, Peppol schematron rule IDs)

conflictTarget.description: On 409 from a unique-constraint collision: comma-joined target columns (e.g. `firm_id,idempotency_key`).

ForbiddenErrorResponse.description: 403 variant of `ErrorResponse`. The 401/403 responses also include `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"|"insufficient_scope" scope="<required-scope>"` per RFC 6750 — clients should parse `scope="…"` to learn what scope is required.

SimpleErrorResponse.description: Compatibility non-canonical error shape used by a few multipart upload endpoints (e.g. `/extract`). Standard endpoints use `ErrorResponse`.

DocumentStatusResponse.description:
Stav dokumentu z pohľadu volajúceho — `direction` rozlišuje, či ide o **inbound** riadok (prijímateľ) alebo **outbound** riadok (odosielateľ). To isté Peppol message ID môže existovať na oboch stranách (prijímateľ aj odosielateľ majú vlastný riadok), ale ich timestampy a stavy sú **nezávislé**:

- `deliveredAt` a `acknowledgedAt` na **inbound** riadku nastavuje prijímateľ cez `POST /documents/{id}/mark` resp. `POST /documents/inbox/{id}/acknowledge`. Tieto signály sú **lokálne** — Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 pre ne nemá ekvivalentnú správu, takže sa neposielajú odosielateľovi.
- `acknowledgedAt` na **outbound** riadku sa vyplní iba vtedy, keď cez Peppol AS4 dorazí Invoice Response (kódy AP / AB / RE / …) — to je sieťový signál vygenerovaný cez `POST /documents/{id}/respond`.
- `deliveredAt` na **outbound** riadku sa nikdy nepropaguje z prijímateľa. Ak odosielateľ potrebuje vidieť, že prijímateľ doručil/spracoval dokument, prijímateľ musí volať `/respond` s vhodným kódom (`AP` = accepted, `IP` = in process, `RE` = rejected). Doručenie faktúry a TDD reporting sú samostatné: tdd.status=submitted znamená odoslanie, accepted vyžaduje MLS AP a rejected označuje MLS RE k TDD.

direction.description: `inbound` = my sme prijímateľ (faktúru sme dostali). `outbound` = my sme odosielateľ. Určuje sémantiku timestampov: kto čo nastavuje a kedy.

deliveredAt.description: Inbound: nastavené prijímateľom cez `/mark state=delivered`. Outbound: vždy `null` — Peppol nemá delivery callback.

acknowledgedAt.description: Inbound: nastavené prijímateľom cez `/acknowledge` alebo `/mark state=processed`. Outbound: nastavené v okamihu, keď nám AS4 doručí prijímateľov Invoice Response (cez `/respond`) — pokrýva celú sieťovú latenciu, takže timestamp sa typicky líši od inbound `acknowledgedAt`.

cancel.description: Present only when the staged document can be cancelled before sending starts.

links.description: Action links are capability-driven. send and cancel are present only while a staged document is eligible for those actions; acknowledge is present only for an unprocessed inbound document.

businessType.description: Exact business subtype for UBL 383, 384 or 386. Present only for these subtypes. The existing type/documentType/docType field retains invoice for compatibility; use businessType when present, otherwise the existing family field.

requestId.description: Correlation ID echoed in the X-Request-Id response header. Invalid incoming IDs are replaced.

country.description: ISO country code that determines how the ordinary identifier is interpreted.

companyId.description: Company registration number for this country. Do not put a tax or VAT identifier in this field.

taxId.description: Local tax identifier for this country. Do not put a company registration or VAT identifier in this field.

vatId.description: VAT identifier for this country. Do not put a company registration or local tax identifier in this field.

networkId.description: Optional expert override. The identifier is still verified before use.

quantity.description: Positive for standard lines; negative for lineType=advance_deduction. Zero is never allowed.

taxExemptionReasonCode.description: Peppol BT-121 VAT exemption reason code from the current CEF VATEX list. The code must match taxTreatment and is allowed only for exempt or non-taxable values.

taxExemptionReason.description: Peppol BT-120 human-readable VAT exemption reason. Allowed only for exempt or non-taxable taxTreatment values.

lineType.description: advance_deduction requires a negative quantity and advanceInvoiceReference.

allOf.description: A successful JSON billing request needs a Peppol recipient ID. Use receiverPeppolId for invoice/credit_note; self-billing may use supplierPeppolId.
A successful JSON billing request needs the counterparty legal name. Use receiverName for invoice/credit_note; self-billing may use supplierName.

LegacySendDocumentJsonRequest.description: Released billing input subset retained as an accepted compatibility branch. New requests may also use the expanded SendDocumentJsonRequest.

processId.description: Peppol process URN. Accepts the bare URN or the cenbii-procid-ubl:: prefixed form. Defaults to profile 01; use urn:peppol:bis:billing_with_response to require an Invoice Response.

documentType.description: Business document type. invoice is a supplier-issued invoice; credit_note corrects a supplier-issued invoice; self_billing is a buyer-issued invoice; self_billing_credit_note corrects a buyer-issued invoice. Defaults to invoice.

document_type.description: Snake_case alias for documentType. If multiple aliases are sent, all non-empty values must match.

docType.description: Compatibility alias for documentType. Do not send conflicting alias values.

receiverPeppolId.description: Peppol participant ID in scheme:identifier form, for example 0245:2123456789. Required for invoice/credit_note and identifies the buyer. For self-billing it identifies the supplier/Peppol recipient, but supplierPeppolId is the clearer alias.

supplierPeppolId.description: Self-billing alias for the supplier/Peppol recipient in scheme:identifier form. Allowed only for self_billing and self_billing_credit_note; it is normalized into receiverPeppolId.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice or credit-note number. If omitted or empty, ePošťák allocates the next number from the authenticated firm's numbering sequence.

precedingInvoiceRef.description: External original invoice number corrected by this credit note. Required for credit_note and self_billing_credit_note; emitted as UBL BillingReference.

issueDate.description: Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Through 2026 a supplied value is preserved. From 1 January 2027 the legal issue date is the Europe/Bratislava handoff day; generated JSON is normalized and raw UBL with a different IssueDate is rejected.

dueDate.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional.

taxPointDate.description: VAT tax point date (BT-7) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Kept separate from the actual delivery date.

deliveryDate.description: Actual delivery date for the whole document (BT-72) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

documentDiscountPercent.description: Document-level discount percentage represented as a Peppol BG-20 allowance. This is additional to any items[].discount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. If omitted, the authenticated firm's default currency is used, falling back to EUR.

note.description: Free-text invoice note. Use it for a human-readable exemption/reverse-charge reason or other information the receiver must see.

iban.description: Payment IBAN. If omitted, the authenticated firm's saved IBAN is used when available.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method. Accepted convenience aliases: bank_transfer=30, credit_transfer=30, sepa=58, card=48, cash=10, direct_debit=49. A direct UNCL4461 code such as 30 is also accepted. Omitted defaults to 30 in generated UBL.

variableSymbol.description: Variable symbol / payment reference included with payment means.

buyerReference.description: Buyer reference, purchase-order number, or internal procurement reference.

receiverName.description: Counterparty legal/business name. Required for invoice/credit_note. For self-billing it identifies the supplier, but supplierName is the clearer alias.

receiverIcDph.description: Counterparty VAT identification number (IČ DPH). For self-billing it is also used to determine supplier-side VAT-payer treatment.

receiverStreet.description: Receiver street and number. Preferred over parsing receiverAddress.

receiverAddress.description: Single-line counterparty address. Prefer receiverStreet, receiverCity and receiverPostalCode when the ERP has split address fields.

receiverCountry.description: Counterparty country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Defaults to SK.

supplierName.description: Self-billing alias for receiverName (supplier). Required for self_billing/self_billing_credit_note when receiverName is omitted.

supplierIcDph.description: Self-billing alias for receiverIcDph. Used for supplier-side VAT payer logic.

prepaidAmount.description: Amount paid in advance (BT-113). Emitted as LegalMonetaryTotal/PrepaidAmount and reduces PayableAmount. Do not combine with items[].lineType=advance_deduction.

prepayments.description: Structured settled prepayments on the final invoice. The API sums prepayments[].amountWithVat into prepaidAmount, reduces PayableAmount, and preserves advance/tax references in the UBL note. It does not create a separate UBL tax breakdown for the prepayment; tax subtotals still come from invoice lines. Do not combine with items[].lineType=advance_deduction.

items.description: Billing lines. Between 1 and 999 entries are accepted.

attachments.description: Invoice supporting documents (Peppol BG-24), embedded in UBL as base64 through AdditionalDocumentReference / EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject. Maximum 20 files, 10 MB decoded per file, and 15 MB decoded total.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the rate-limit window resets

ConnectorPointCustomerRef.name: customerRef
ConnectorPointCustomerRef.description: Optional only for backward compatibility of released raw HTTP point-resource calls; official SDKs and the focused Connector profile always send it. If supplied, provide exactly one non-blank value matching the document customerRef. A blank, repeated, or mismatched value returns the same opaque 404 as an unavailable document. Omitted legacy calls remain restricted by the authenticated integrator, active firm consent, active Connector mailbox, and opaque document ID.

WhiteLabelIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
WhiteLabelIdempotencyKey.description: Unique retry key for this command. Reuse the same key and identical body until a terminal result; never retry an unknown SMP result with a new key.
